hypotheses: H1: on T3 the tag-direction projection (V5) yields a higher positive-class F1 (threshold 0.5) than STE (V0) under the full HGS + fuzzy-OWA pipeline.
H2: on T3 the tag-direction projection (V5) yields a higher ROC area than STE (V0) under the same pipeline.
protocol.rationale: Exploratory analysis on seeds 42, 7 and 123 (notebook 11) showed a small, non-significant F1 gain and a per-seed significant ROC-area gain on T3; both are tested here on new seeds.
protocol.split: stratified 70/30 on the raw code, random_state = seed
protocol.search: HGS pop 12, 18 iterations, patience 4; fuzzy OWA over F1, recall, ROC area; orness 0.30; gap penalty 0.50
protocol.primary_test: for each metric, one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the paired seed differences V5 - V0; Holm correction over the two hypotheses, family-wise alpha 0.05
secondary: per-seed DeLong test of ROC areas
protocol.decision: Each hypothesis is CONFIRMED if its Holm-adjusted p-value < 0.05 once all 10 seeds are complete; otherwise NOT CONFIRMED
